"""
增量索引模块

提供代码库的增量索引功能:
- IncrementalIndexer: 增量索引器，只处理变更的文件
- ChangeDetector: 变更检测器，检测文件变更
- IndexScheduler: 索引调度器，管理索引任务

作者: Claude
日期: 2024
"""

import os
import time
import hashlib
import threading
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import (
    Dict, List, Optional, Any, Set, Tuple,
    Iterator, Callable, Union
)
from enum import Enum
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

from ..parsers.base import BaseParser
from ..extractors.entity_extractor import EntityExtractor
from ..extractors.relation_extractor import RelationExtractor
from ..memory.managers import ProjectMemory
from ..models.entities import CodeEntity


# ============================================================================
# 数据类型
# ============================================================================

class ChangeType(Enum):
    """变更类型"""
    ADDED = "added"      # 新增文件
    MODIFIED = "modified"  # 修改文件
    DELETED = "deleted"   # 删除文件
    RENAMED = "renamed"   # 重命名文件


@dataclass
class FileChange:
    """
    文件变更信息
    
    Attributes:
        file_path: 文件路径
        change_type: 变更类型
        old_path: 旧路径（重命名时使用）
        old_hash: 旧文件哈希
        new_hash: 新文件哈希
        timestamp: 变更时间戳
    """
    file_path: str
    change_type: ChangeType
    old_path: Optional[str] = None
    old_hash: Optional[str] = None
    new_hash: Optional[str] = None
    timestamp: float = field(default_factory=time.time)


@dataclass
class IndexStats:
    """
    索引统计信息
    
    Attributes:
        total_files: 总文件数
        indexed_files: 已索引文件数
        failed_files: 失败文件数
        total_entities: 总实体数
        total_relations: 总关系数
        index_time: 索引耗时（秒）
        last_index_time: 上次索引时间
    """
    total_files: int = 0
    indexed_files: int = 0
    failed_files: int = 0
    total_entities: int = 0
    total_relations: int = 0
    index_time: float = 0.0
    last_index_time: Optional[datetime] = None
    
    # 增量统计
    added_files: int = 0
    modified_files: int = 0
    deleted_files: int = 0


@dataclass 
class FileState:
    """
    文件状态
    
    用于跟踪文件的索引状态。
    
    Attributes:
        path: 文件路径
        content_hash: 内容哈希
        mtime: 修改时间
        size: 文件大小
        indexed_at: 索引时间
        entity_ids: 关联的实体ID列表
    """
    path: str
    content_hash: str
    mtime: float
    size: int
    indexed_at: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    entity_ids: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)


# ============================================================================
# 变更检测器
# ============================================================================

class ChangeDetector:
    """
    变更检测器
    
    检测代码库中的文件变更，支持:
    - 基于修改时间的检测
    - 基于内容哈希的检测
    - Git集成检测
    
    Attributes:
        root_path: 代码库根路径
        file_patterns: 文件匹配模式
        exclude_patterns: 排除模式
        _state: 文件状态缓存
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        root_path: str,
        file_patterns: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        exclude_patterns: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        use_git: bool = True
    ):
        """
        初始化变更检测器
        
        Args:
            root_path: 代码库根路径
            file_patterns: 文件匹配模式，如 ["*.py", "*.js"]
            exclude_patterns: 排除模式，如 ["*test*", "__pycache__"]
            use_git: 是否使用Git检测
        """
        self.root_path = Path(root_path).resolve()
        self.file_patterns = file_patterns or ["*.py"]
        self.exclude_patterns = exclude_patterns or [
            "__pycache__", "*.pyc", ".git", "node_modules",
            "venv", ".venv", "env", ".env", "dist", "build"
        ]
        self.use_git = use_git
        
        # 文件状态缓存
        self._state: Dict[str, FileState] = {}
        
    def detect_changes(self) -> List[FileChange]:
        """
        检测文件变更
        
        Returns:
            变更列表
        """
        if self.use_git and self._is_git_repo():
            return self._detect_git_changes()
        else:
            return self._detect_filesystem_changes()
    
    def _is_git_repo(self) -> bool:
        """检查是否为Git仓库"""
        git_dir = self.root_path / ".git"
        return git_dir.exists()
    
    def _detect_git_changes(self) -> List[FileChange]:
        """使用Git检测变更"""
        import subprocess
        
        changes = []
        
        try:
            # 获取未提交的修改
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["git", "status", "--porcelain"],
                cwd=str(self.root_path),
                capture_output=True,
                text=True
            )
            
            for line in result.stdout.strip().split("\n"):
                if not line:
                    continue
                    
                status = line[:2].strip()
                file_path = line[3:].strip()
                
                # 处理重命名
                if " -> " in file_path:
                    old_path, new_path = file_path.split(" -> ")
                    file_path = new_path
                else:
                    old_path = None
                
                # 过滤文件
                if not self._match_patterns(file_path):
                    continue
                    
                # 映射状态
                if status in ("A", "?"):
                    change_type = ChangeType.ADDED
                elif status == "M":
                    change_type = ChangeType.MODIFIED
                elif status == "D":
                    change_type = ChangeType.DELETED
                elif status == "R":
                    change_type = ChangeType.RENAMED
                else:
                    continue
                    
                full_path = str(self.root_path / file_path)
                changes.append(FileChange(
                    file_path=full_path,
                    change_type=change_type,
                    old_path=str(self.root_path / old_path) if old_path else None,
                    new_hash=self._compute_hash(full_path) if change_type != ChangeType.DELETED else None
                ))
                
        except Exception:
            # Git命令失败，回退到文件系统检测
            return self._detect_filesystem_changes()
            
        return changes
    
    def _detect_filesystem_changes(self) -> List[FileChange]:
        """使用文件系统检测变更"""
        changes = []
        current_files: Set[str] = set()
        
        # 扫描当前文件
        for file_path in self._scan_files():
            current_files.add(file_path)
            
            # 获取文件信息
            stat = os.stat(file_path)
            content_hash = self._compute_hash(file_path)
            
            if file_path in self._state:
                # 检查是否修改
                old_state = self._state[file_path]
                if content_hash != old_state.content_hash:
                    changes.append(FileChange(
                        file_path=file_path,
                        change_type=ChangeType.MODIFIED,
                        old_hash=old_state.content_hash,
                        new_hash=content_hash
                    ))
            else:
                # 新文件
                changes.append(FileChange(
                    file_path=file_path,
                    change_type=ChangeType.ADDED,
                    new_hash=content_hash
                ))
                
        # 检查删除的文件
        for file_path in self._state:
            if file_path not in current_files:
                changes.append(FileChange(
                    file_path=file_path,
                    change_type=ChangeType.DELETED,
                    old_hash=self._state[file_path].content_hash
                ))
                
        return changes
    
    def _scan_files(self) -> Iterator[str]:
        """扫描匹配的文件"""
        import fnmatch
        
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(self.root_path):
            # 过滤排除目录
            dirs[:] = [
                d for d in dirs 
                if not any(fnmatch.fnmatch(d, p) for p in self.exclude_patterns)
            ]
            
            for file in files:
                file_path = os.path.join(root, file)
                
                # 检查匹配模式
                if self._match_patterns(file):
                    yield file_path
                    
    def _match_patterns(self, file_path: str) -> bool:
        """检查文件是否匹配模式"""
        import fnmatch
        
        file_name = os.path.basename(file_path)
        
        # 检查排除模式
        for pattern in self.exclude_patterns:
            if fnmatch.fnmatch(file_name, pattern):
                return False
            if fnmatch.fnmatch(file_path, pattern):
                return False
                
        # 检查包含模式
        for pattern in self.file_patterns:
            if fnmatch.fnmatch(file_name, pattern):
                return True
                
        return False
    
    def _compute_hash(self, file_path: str) -> str:
        """计算文件内容哈希"""
        try:
            with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
                return hashlib.md5(f.read()).hexdigest()
        except Exception:
            return ""
    
    def update_state(self, file_path: str, entity_ids: List[str]):
        """
        更新文件状态
        
        Args:
            file_path: 文件路径
            entity_ids: 关联的实体ID
        """
        try:
            stat = os.stat(file_path)
            self._state[file_path] = FileState(
                path=file_path,
                content_hash=self._compute_hash(file_path),
                mtime=stat.st_mtime,
                size=stat.st_size,
                entity_ids=entity_ids
            )
        except Exception:
            pass
    
    def remove_state(self, file_path: str):
        """移除文件状态"""
        self._state.pop(file_path, None)
        
    def get_entity_ids(self, file_path: str) -> List[str]:
        """获取文件关联的实体ID"""
        state = self._state.get(file_path)
        return state.entity_ids if state else []
    
    def save_state(self, state_file: str):
        """保存状态到文件"""
        import json
        
        data = {
            path: {
                "content_hash": s.content_hash,
                "mtime": s.mtime,
                "size": s.size,
                "indexed_at": s.indexed_at,
                "entity_ids": s.entity_ids
            }
            for path, s in self._state.items()
        }
        
        with open(state_file, "w") as f:
            json.dump(data, f)
    
    def load_state(self, state_file: str):
        """从文件加载状态"""
        import json
        
        try:
            with open(state_file, "r") as f:
                data = json.load(f)
                
            self._state = {
                path: FileState(
                    path=path,
                    content_hash=s["content_hash"],
                    mtime=s["mtime"],
                    size=s["size"],
                    indexed_at=s.get("indexed_at", 0),
                    entity_ids=s.get("entity_ids", [])
                )
                for path, s in data.items()
            }
        except Exception:
            self._state = {}


# ============================================================================
# 增量索引器
# ============================================================================

class IncrementalIndexer:
    """
    增量索引器
    
    只处理变更的文件，提高索引效率。
    
    Attributes:
        memory: 项目记忆
        parser: 代码解析器
        entity_extractor: 实体提取器
        relation_extractor: 关系提取器
        change_detector: 变更检测器
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        memory: ProjectMemory,
        parser: BaseParser,
        change_detector: ChangeDetector,
        max_workers: int = 4
    ):
        """
        初始化增量索引器
        
        Args:
            memory: 项目记忆实例
            parser: 代码解析器实例
            change_detector: 变更检测器实例
            max_workers: 并行工作线程数
        """
        self.memory = memory
        self.parser = parser
        self.change_detector = change_detector
        self.max_workers = max_workers
        
        # 提取器
        self.entity_extractor = EntityExtractor()
        self.relation_extractor = RelationExtractor()
        
        # 统计
        self._stats = IndexStats()
        
    def index_full(self, root_path: str) -> IndexStats:
        """
        全量索引
        
        Args:
            root_path: 代码库根路径
            
        Returns:
            索引统计信息
        """
        start_time = time.time()
        self._stats = IndexStats()
        
        # 扫描所有文件
        files = list(self.change_detector._scan_files())
        self._stats.total_files = len(files)
        
        # 并行处理
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=self.max_workers) as executor:
            futures = {
                executor.submit(self._index_file, f): f 
                for f in files
            }
            
            for future in as_completed(futures):
                file_path = futures[future]
                try:
                    entity_ids = future.result()
                    if entity_ids:
                        self._stats.indexed_files += 1
                        self.change_detector.update_state(file_path, entity_ids)
                except Exception as e:
                    self._stats.failed_files += 1
                    
        self._stats.index_time = time.time() - start_time
        self._stats.last_index_time = datetime.now()
        
        return self._stats
    
    def index_incremental(self) -> IndexStats:
        """
        增量索引
        
        只处理变更的文件。
        
        Returns:
            索引统计信息
        """
        start_time = time.time()
        self._stats = IndexStats()
        
        # 检测变更
        changes = self.change_detector.detect_changes()
        
        for change in changes:
            try:
                if change.change_type == ChangeType.ADDED:
                    entity_ids = self._index_file(change.file_path)
                    if entity_ids:
                        self.change_detector.update_state(change.file_path, entity_ids)
                        self._stats.added_files += 1
                        
                elif change.change_type == ChangeType.MODIFIED:
                    # 先删除旧实体
                    old_entity_ids = self.change_detector.get_entity_ids(change.file_path)
                    for entity_id in old_entity_ids:
                        self.memory.delete_entity(entity_id)
                        
                    # 重新索引
                    entity_ids = self._index_file(change.file_path)
                    if entity_ids:
                        self.change_detector.update_state(change.file_path, entity_ids)
                        self._stats.modified_files += 1
                        
                elif change.change_type == ChangeType.DELETED:
                    # 删除关联实体
                    old_entity_ids = self.change_detector.get_entity_ids(change.file_path)
                    for entity_id in old_entity_ids:
                        self.memory.delete_entity(entity_id)
                    self.change_detector.remove_state(change.file_path)
                    self._stats.deleted_files += 1
                    
                elif change.change_type == ChangeType.RENAMED:
                    # 处理重命名
                    if change.old_path:
                        old_entity_ids = self.change_detector.get_entity_ids(change.old_path)
                        for entity_id in old_entity_ids:
                            self.memory.delete_entity(entity_id)
                        self.change_detector.remove_state(change.old_path)
                        
                    entity_ids = self._index_file(change.file_path)
                    if entity_ids:
                        self.change_detector.update_state(change.file_path, entity_ids)
                        self._stats.modified_files += 1
                        
                self._stats.indexed_files += 1
                
            except Exception as e:
                self._stats.failed_files += 1
                
        self._stats.index_time = time.time() - start_time
        self._stats.last_index_time = datetime.now()
        
        return self._stats
    
    def _index_file(self, file_path: str) -> List[str]:
        """
        索引单个文件
        
        Args:
            file_path: 文件路径
            
        Returns:
            创建的实体ID列表
        """
        entity_ids = []
        
        try:
            # 读取文件
            with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
                source_code = f.read()
                
            # 解析文件
            parse_result = self.parser.parse(source_code, file_path)
            
            if not parse_result.ast:
                return entity_ids
                
            # 提取实体
            entities = self.entity_extractor.extract(
                ast=parse_result.ast,
                file_path=file_path,
                source_code=source_code
            )
            
            # 提取关系
            relations = self.relation_extractor.extract(
                ast=parse_result.ast,
                entities=entities
            )
            
            # 存储到内存
            for entity in entities:
                if self.memory.add_entity(entity):
                    entity_ids.append(entity.id)
                    self._stats.total_entities += 1
                    
            for relation in relations:
                if self.memory.add_relation(relation):
                    self._stats.total_relations += 1
                    
        except Exception as e:
            pass
            
        return entity_ids
    
    def reindex_file(self, file_path: str) -> List[str]:
        """
        重新索引单个文件
        
        Args:
            file_path: 文件路径
            
        Returns:
            创建的实体ID列表
        """
        # 删除旧实体
        old_entity_ids = self.change_detector.get_entity_ids(file_path)
        for entity_id in old_entity_ids:
            self.memory.delete_entity(entity_id)
            
        # 重新索引
        entity_ids = self._index_file(file_path)
        
        # 更新状态
        if entity_ids:
            self.change_detector.update_state(file_path, entity_ids)
            
        return entity_ids
    
    def stats(self) -> IndexStats:
        """获取统计信息"""
        return self._stats


# ============================================================================
# 索引调度器
# ============================================================================

class IndexScheduler:
    """
    索引调度器
    
    管理索引任务的调度和执行。
    
    Attributes:
        indexer: 增量索引器
        interval: 调度间隔（秒）
        auto_start: 是否自动启动
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        indexer: IncrementalIndexer,
        interval: int = 60,
        auto_start: bool = False
    ):
        """
        初始化索引调度器
        
        Args:
            indexer: 增量索引器实例
            interval: 调度间隔（秒）
            auto_start: 是否自动启动
        """
        self.indexer = indexer
        self.interval = interval
        
        self._running = False
        self._thread: Optional[threading.Thread] = None
        self._callbacks: List[Callable[[IndexStats], None]] = []
        
        if auto_start:
            self.start()
            
    def start(self):
        """启动调度器"""
        if self._running:
            return
            
        self._running = True
        self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run, daemon=True)
        self._thread.start()
        
    def stop(self):
        """停止调度器"""
        self._running = False
        if self._thread:
            self._thread.join(timeout=5)
            self._thread = None
            
    def _run(self):
        """调度器主循环"""
        while self._running:
            try:
                # 执行增量索引
                stats = self.indexer.index_incremental()
                
                # 触发回调
                for callback in self._callbacks:
                    try:
                        callback(stats)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                        
            except Exception:
                pass
                
            # 等待下一次执行
            time.sleep(self.interval)
            
    def on_index_complete(self, callback: Callable[[IndexStats], None]):
        """
        注册索引完成回调
        
        Args:
            callback: 回调函数，接收IndexStats参数
        """
        self._callbacks.append(callback)
        
    def trigger_now(self) -> IndexStats:
        """
        立即触发索引
        
        Returns:
            索引统计信息
        """
        return self.indexer.index_incremental()
    
    def is_running(self) -> bool:
        """检查调度器是否运行中"""
        return self._running


# ============================================================================
# 工具函数
# ============================================================================

def create_indexer(
    memory: ProjectMemory,
    parser: BaseParser,
    root_path: str,
    file_patterns: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    exclude_patterns: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    max_workers: int = 4
) -> IncrementalIndexer:
    """
    创建增量索引器
    
    Args:
        memory: 项目记忆
        parser: 代码解析器
        root_path: 代码库根路径
        file_patterns: 文件匹配模式
        exclude_patterns: 排除模式
        max_workers: 并行工作线程数
        
    Returns:
        配置好的增量索引器
    """
    change_detector = ChangeDetector(
        root_path=root_path,
        file_patterns=file_patterns,
        exclude_patterns=exclude_patterns
    )
    
    return IncrementalIndexer(
        memory=memory,
        parser=parser,
        change_detector=change_detector,
        max_workers=max_workers
    )

class CLIFormatter:
    """CLI输出格式化器 / CLI output formatter."""
    
    # ANSI颜色代码 / ANSI color codes
    COLORS = {
        'reset': '\033[0m',
        'bold': '\033[1m',
        'red': '\033[91m',
        'green': '\033[92m',
        'yellow': '\033[93m',
        'blue': '\033[94m',
        'magenta': '\033[95m',
        'cyan': '\033[96m',
    }
    
    def __init__(self, use_color: bool = True):
        """
        初始化格式化器。
        
        Args:
            use_color: 是否使用颜色输出
        """
        self.use_color = use_color and sys.stdout.isatty()
    
    def color(self, text: str, color: str) -> str:
        """
        为文本添加颜色。
        
        Args:
            text: 要着色的文本
            color: 颜色名称
            
        Returns:
            着色后的文本
        """
        if not self.use_color or color not in self.COLORS:
            return text
        return f"{self.COLORS[color]}{text}{self.COLORS['reset']}"
    
    def header(self, text: str) -> str:
        """格式化标题 / Format header."""
        return self.color(f"\n{'='*60}\n{text}\n{'='*60}", 'cyan')
    
    def success(self, text: str) -> str:
        """格式化成功消息 / Format success message."""
        return self.color(f"✓ {text}", 'green')
    
    def error(self, text: str) -> str:
        """格式化错误消息 / Format error message."""
        return self.color(f"✗ {text}", 'red')
    
    def warning(self, text: str) -> str:
        """格式化警告消息 / Format warning message."""
        return self.color(f"⚠ {text}", 'yellow')

        """格式化信息消息 / Format info message."""
        return self.color(f"ℹ {text}", 'blue')

        """

        Args:

        """
        lines = []
        name = entity.get('name', 'Unknown')
        entity_type = entity.get('type', 'Unknown')
        file_path = entity.get('file_path', 'Unknown')
        
        lines.append(self.color(f"  {name}", 'bold'))
        lines.append(f"    Type: {self.color(entity_type, 'magenta')}")
        lines.append(f"    File: {self.color(file_path, 'cyan')}")
        
        if 'line_start' in entity:
            lines.append(f"    Lines: {entity['line_start']}-{entity.get('line_end', '?')}")
        
        if 'docstring' in entity and entity['docstring']:
            doc = entity['docstring'][:100] + '...' if len(entity['docstring']) > 100 else entity['docstring']
            lines.append(f"    Doc: {doc}")
        
        return '\n'.join(lines)
    
    def format_search_result(self, result: Dict[str, Any], index: int) -> str:
        """
        格式化搜索结果。
        
        Args:
            result: 搜索结果字典
            index: 结果索引
            
        Returns:
            格式化的字符串
        """
        lines = []
        score = result.get('score', 0)
        entity = result.get('entity', {})
        
        lines.append(self.color(f"\n[{index + 1}] Score: {score:.4f}", 'yellow'))
        lines.append(self.format_entity(entity))
        
        return '\n'.join(lines)
    
    def format_stats(self, stats: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        """
        格式化统计信息。
        
        Args:
            stats: 统计字典
            
        Returns:
            格式化的字符串
        """
        lines = [self.header("Statistics")]
        
        for key, value in stats.items():
            if isinstance(value, dict):
                lines.append(f"\n{self.color(key, 'bold')}:")
                for k, v in value.items():
                    lines.append(f"  {k}: {v}")
            else:
                lines.append(f"{key}: {value}")
        
        return '\n'.join(lines)

            '--value', '-v',
            type=str,
            help='配置值 / Config value'
        )
        
        return parser
    
    def cmd_init(self, args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
        """
        处理init命令。
        
        Args:
            args: 命令行参数
            
        Returns:
            退出码
        """
        path = Path(args.path).resolve()
        
        if not path.exists():
            print(self.formatter.error(f"路径不存在 / Path does not exist: {path}"))
            return 1
        
        if not path.is_dir():
            print(self.formatter.error(f"路径不是目录 / Path is not a directory: {path}"))
            return 1
        
        project_name = args.name or path.name
        
        print(self.formatter.info(f"初始化项目 / Initializing project: {project_name}"))
        print(self.formatter.info(f"路径 / Path: {path}"))
        
        try:
            # 初始化项目
            self.code_memory.init_project(
                project_name=project_name,
                project_path=str(path),
                exclude_patterns=args.exclude,
                file_extensions=args.extensions
            )
            
            # 执行初始索引
            print(self.formatter.info("开始索引 / Starting indexing..."))
            stats = self.code_memory.index_project(project_name)
            
            print(self.formatter.success(f"项目初始化完成 / Project initialized successfully"))
            print(f"  文件数 / Files: {stats.get('files_processed', 0)}")
            print(f"  实体数 / Entities: {stats.get('entities_extracted', 0)}")
            print(f"  关系数 / Relations: {stats.get('relations_extracted', 0)}")
            
            return 0
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(self.formatter.error(f"初始化失败 / Initialization failed: {e}"))
            return 1
    
    def cmd_index(self, args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
        """
        处理index命令。
        
        Args:
            args: 命令行参数
            
        Returns:
            退出码
        """
        project = args.project or self.code_memory.current_project
        
        if not project:
            print(self.formatter.error("未指定项目 / No project specified"))
            return 1
        
        print(self.formatter.info(f"更新索引 / Updating index: {project}"))
        
        try:
            if args.full:
                print(self.formatter.info("执行完整重新索引 / Performing full reindex"))
                stats = self.code_memory.reindex_project(project)
            else:
                stats = self.code_memory.index_project(project, incremental=True)
            
            print(self.formatter.success("索引更新完成 / Index updated successfully"))
            print(f"  处理文件 / Files processed: {stats.get('files_processed', 0)}")
            print(f"  新增实体 / Entities added: {stats.get('entities_added', 0)}")
            print(f"  更新实体 / Entities updated: {stats.get('entities_updated', 0)}")
            print(f"  删除实体 / Entities removed: {stats.get('entities_removed', 0)}")
            
            return 0
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(self.formatter.error(f"索引失败 / Indexing failed: {e}"))
            return 1
    
    def cmd_search(self, args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
        """
        处理search命令。
        
        Args:
            args: 命令行参数
            
        Returns:
            退出码
        """
        print(self.formatter.info(f"搜索 / Searching: {args.query}"))
        
        try:
            # 构建过滤器
            filters = {}
            if args.type != 'all':
                filters['entity_type'] = args.type
            
            if args.project:
                self.code_memory.switch_project(args.project)
            
            # 执行搜索
            results = self.code_memory.search(
                query=args.query,
                mode=args.mode,
                limit=args.limit,
                filters=filters
            )
            
            if not results:
                print(self.formatter.warning("未找到结果 / No results found"))
                return 0
            
            print(self.formatter.header(f"搜索结果 / Search Results ({len(results)} found)"))
            
            for i, result in enumerate(results):
                print(self.formatter.format_search_result(result, i))
            
            return 0
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(self.formatter.error(f"搜索失败 / Search failed: {e}"))
            return 1
    
    def cmd_find(self, args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
        """
        处理find命令。
        
        Args:
            args: 命令行参数
            
        Returns:
            退出码
        """
        print(self.formatter.info(f"查找 / Finding: {args.name}"))
        
        try:
            if args.project:
                self.code_memory.switch_project(args.project)
            
            # 查找实体
            entities = self.code_memory.find_entity(
                name=args.name,
                exact_match=args.exact
            )
            
            if not entities:
                print(self.formatter.warning("未找到实体 / Entity not found"))
                return 0
            
            print(self.formatter.header(f"找到实体 / Found Entities ({len(entities)})"))
            
            for entity in entities:
                print(self.formatter.format_entity(entity))
                print()
            
            return 0
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(self.formatter.error(f"查找失败 / Find failed: {e}"))
            return 1
    
    def cmd_analyze(self, args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
        """
        处理analyze命令。
        
        Args:
            args: 命令行参数
            
        Returns:
            退出码
        """
        print(self.formatter.info(f"分析类型 / Analysis type: {args.type}"))
        
        try:
            if args.project:
                self.code_memory.switch_project(args.project)
            
            results = {}
            
            if args.type in ['calls', 'all']:
                if args.function:
                    results['call_chain'] = self.code_memory.analyze_call_chain(
                        args.function,
                        max_depth=args.depth
                    )
                else:
                    results['call_graph_metrics'] = self.code_memory.get_call_graph_metrics()
            
            if args.type in ['inheritance', 'all']:
                if args.class_name:
                    results['class_hierarchy'] = self.code_memory.analyze_class_hierarchy(
                        args.class_name
                    )
                else:
                    results['inheritance_metrics'] = self.code_memory.get_inheritance_metrics()
            
            if args.type in ['dependencies', 'all']:
                results['dependencies'] = self.code_memory.analyze_dependencies()
            
            if args.type in ['metrics', 'all']:
                results['metrics'] = self.code_memory.get_graph_metrics()
            
            # 输出结果
            print(self.formatter.header("分析结果 / Analysis Results"))
            print(json.dumps(results, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str))
            
            return 0
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(self.formatter.error(f"分析失败 / Analysis failed: {e}"))
            return 1
    
    def cmd_stats(self, args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
        """
        处理stats命令。
        
        Args:
            args: 命令行参数
            
        Returns:
            退出码
        """
        try:
            if args.project:
                self.code_memory.switch_project(args.project)
            
            stats = self.code_memory.get_statistics(detailed=args.detailed)
            
            print(self.formatter.format_stats(stats))
            
            return 0
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(self.formatter.error(f"获取统计失败 / Failed to get statistics: {e}"))
            return 1
    
    def cmd_export(self, args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
        """
        处理export命令。
        
        Args:
            args: 命令行参数
            
        Returns:
            退出码
        """
        print(self.formatter.info(f"导出格式 / Export format: {args.format}"))
        print(self.formatter.info(f"输出文件 / Output file: {args.output}"))
        
        try:
            if args.project:
                self.code_memory.switch_project(args.project)
            
            self.code_memory.export(
                output_path=args.output,
                format=args.format
            )
            
            print(self.formatter.success(f"导出成功 / Export successful: {args.output}"))
            
            return 0
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(self.formatter.error(f"导出失败 / Export failed: {e}"))
            return 1
    
    def cmd_list(self, args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
        """
        处理list命令。
        
        Args:
            args: 命令行参数
            
        Returns:
            退出码
        """
        try:
            if args.what == 'projects':
                projects = self.code_memory.list_projects()
                print(self.formatter.header(f"项目列表 / Projects ({len(projects)})"))
                for p in projects:
                    print(f"  - {p}")
                return 0
            
            if args.project:
                self.code_memory.switch_project(args.project)
            
            if args.what == 'files':
                files = self.code_memory.list_files(limit=args.limit)
                print(self.formatter.header(f"文件列表 / Files ({len(files)})"))
                for f in files:
                    print(f"  {f}")
            
            elif args.what == 'functions':
                functions = self.code_memory.list_entities(
                    entity_type='function',
                    limit=args.limit
                )
                print(self.formatter.header(f"函数列表 / Functions ({len(functions)})"))
                for func in functions:
                    print(f"  {func.get('name', 'Unknown')} @ {func.get('file_path', 'Unknown')}")
            
            elif args.what == 'classes':
                classes = self.code_memory.list_entities(
                    entity_type='class',
                    limit=args.limit
                )
                print(self.formatter.header(f"类列表 / Classes ({len(classes)})"))
                for cls in classes:
                    print(f"  {cls.get('name', 'Unknown')} @ {cls.get('file_path', 'Unknown')}")
            
            elif args.what == 'all':
                entities = self.code_memory.list_entities(limit=args.limit)
                print(self.formatter.header(f"实体列表 / Entities ({len(entities)})"))
                for entity in entities:
                    print(self.formatter.format_entity(entity))
            
            return 0
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(self.formatter.error(f"列出失败 / List failed: {e}"))
            return 1
    
    def cmd_clean(self, args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
        """
        处理clean命令。
        
        Args:
            args: 命令行参数
            
        Returns:
            退出码
        """
        if not args.confirm:
            target = args.project if args.project else "所有项目 / all projects"
            print(self.formatter.warning(f"将清理: {target}"))
            print(self.formatter.warning("使用 --confirm 确认操作 / Use --confirm to confirm"))
            return 1
        
        try:
            if args.project:
                self.code_memory.delete_project(args.project)
                print(self.formatter.success(f"已清理项目 / Project cleaned: {args.project}"))
            else:
                self.code_memory.clear_all()
                print(self.formatter.success("已清理所有数据 / All data cleaned"))
            
            return 0
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(self.formatter.error(f"清理失败 / Clean failed: {e}"))
            return 1
    
    def cmd_config(self, args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
        """
        处理config命令。
        
        Args:
            args: 命令行参数
            
        Returns:
            退出码
        """
        try:
            if args.action == 'show':
                config = self.code_memory.get_config()
                print(self.formatter.header("当前配置 / Current Configuration"))
                print(json.dumps(config, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str))
            
            elif args.action == 'set':
                if not args.key or not args.value:
                    print(self.formatter.error("需要指定 --key 和 --value / --key and --value required"))
                    return 1
                self.code_memory.set_config(args.key, args.value)
                print(self.formatter.success(f"配置已更新 / Config updated: {args.key}={args.value}"))
            
            elif args.action == 'reset':
                self.code_memory.reset_config()
                print(self.formatter.success("配置已重置 / Config reset"))
            
            return 0
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(self.formatter.error(f"配置操作失败 / Config operation failed: {e}"))
            return 1
    
    def run(self, argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> int:
        """
        运行CLI。
        
        Args:
            argv: 命令行参数（None则使用sys.argv）
            
        Returns:
            退出码
        """
        parser = self.create_parser()
        args = parser.parse_args(argv)
        
        # 更新格式化器设置
        if args.no_color:
            self.formatter.use_color = False
        
        # 如果没有命令，显示帮助
        if not args.command:
            parser.print_help()
            return 0
        
        # 路由到对应的命令处理器
        command_handlers = {
            'init': self.cmd_init,
            'index': self.cmd_index,
            'search': self.cmd_search,
            'find': self.cmd_find,
            'analyze': self.cmd_analyze,
            'stats': self.cmd_stats,
            'export': self.cmd_export,
            'list': self.cmd_list,
            'clean': self.cmd_clean,
            'config': self.cmd_config,
        }
        
        handler = command_handlers.get(args.command)
        if handler:
            return handler(args)
        else:
            print(self.formatter.error(f"未知命令 / Unknown command: {args.command}"))
            return 1


def main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> int:
    """
    CLI入口点。
    
    Args:
        argv: 命令行参数
        
    Returns:
        退出码
    """
    cli = CodeMemoryCLI()
    return cli.run(argv)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

# 代码记忆系统 / Code Memory System

智能代码知识库 - 为LLM提供持久化代码理解能力
Intelligent Code Knowledge Base - Persistent Code Understanding for LLMs

特性 • 安装 • 快速开始 • 架构 • API参考

--- ## 简介 / Introduction 代码记忆系统是一个专为大型语言模型(LLM)设计的代码知识库框架。它能够解析、理解和存储代码结构，提供语义搜索、图分析和增量索引等功能，使LLM能够更好地理解和处理代码库。 Code Memory System is a code knowledge base framework designed for Large Language Models (LLMs). It can parse, understand, and store code structures, providing semantic search, graph analysis, and incremental indexing capabilities to help LLMs better understand and process codebases. ## 特性 / Features ### 🔍 多模态检索 / Multi-modal Retrieval - **语义搜索**: 基于代码嵌入的向量搜索 - **结构搜索**: 基于代码图的图遍历搜索 - **词汇搜索**: 基于BM25的文本搜索 - **混合搜索**: 多种检索策略的加权组合 - **融合搜索**: RRF算法实现的排名融合 ### 📊 图分析 / Graph Analysis - **调用图**: 函数调用关系分析，递归检测 - **继承图**: 类继承层次分析，菱形继承检测 - **依赖图**: 模块依赖分析，循环依赖检测 ### 🚀 增量索引 / Incremental Indexing - **Git感知**: 通过Git状态检测文件变更 - **文件系统监控**: 基于哈希的变更检测 - **并行处理**: 多线程文件处理 - **后台调度**: 可配置的定时索引 ### 💾 多层存储 / Multi-tier Storage - **会话内存**: LRU缓存的临时存储 - **项目内存**: 持久化的项目级存储 - **跨项目内存**: 代码模式知识库 ## 安装 / Installation ### 基本安装 / Basic Installation ```bash pip install code-memory ``` ### 完整安装（含GPU支持）/ Full Installation (with GPU) ```bash pip install code-memory[all] ``` ### 从源码安装 / Install from Source ```bash git clone https://github.com/codememory/code-memory-system.git cd code-memory-system pip install -e . ``` ## 快速开始 / Quick Start ### Python API ```python from code_memory import CodeMemory # 创建实例 / Create instance cm = CodeMemory() # 初始化项目 / Initialize project cm.init_project( project_name="my_project", project_path="/path/to/project" ) # 索引项目 / Index project stats = cm.index_project("my_project") print(f"Indexed {stats['entities_extracted']} entities") # 语义搜索 / Semantic search results = cm.search( query="authentication function", mode="hybrid", limit=10 ) for result in results: print(f"{result['entity']['name']}: {result['score']:.4f}") # 图分析 / Graph analysis call_chain = cm.analyze_call_chain("main", max_depth=3) print(call_chain) # 获取统计 / Get statistics stats = cm.get_statistics(detailed=True) print(stats) ``` ### 命令行接口 / CLI ```bash # 初始化项目 / Initialize project code-memory init /path/to/project --name myproject # 搜索代码 / Search code code-memory search "authentication function" --mode hybrid --limit 10 # 分析调用图 / Analyze call graph code-memory analyze calls --function main --depth 3 # 显示统计 / Show statistics code-memory stats --detailed # 导出数据 / Export data code-memory export --format json --output project.json ``` ## 架构 / Architecture ``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ API Layer │ │ ┌─────────────┐ ┌─────────────┐ ┌─────────────┐ │ │ │ CodeMemory │ │ CLI │ │ REST API │ │ │ └─────────────┘ └─────────────┘ └─────────────┘ │ ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ Memory Manager │ │ ┌─────────────┐ ┌─────────────┐ ┌─────────────┐ │ │ │ Session │──│ Project │──│Cross-Project│ │ │ │ Memory │ │ Memory │ │ Memory │ │ │ └─────────────┘ └─────────────┘ └─────────────┘ │ ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ Processing Layer │ │ ┌─────────────┐ ┌─────────────┐ ┌─────────────┐ │ │ │ Parsers │ │ Extractors │ │ Indexer │ │ │ └─────────────┘ └─────────────┘ └─────────────┘ │ │ ┌─────────────┐ ┌─────────────┐ ┌─────────────┐ │ │ │ Embedders │ │ Retrievers │ │ Analyzers │ │ │ └─────────────┘ └─────────────┘ └─────────────┘ │ ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ Storage Layer │ │ ┌─────────────┐ ┌─────────────┐ ┌─────────────┐ │ │ │Vector Store │ │ Graph Store │ │Document Store│ │ │ │Chroma/FAISS │ │ NetworkX │ │ SQLite │ │ │ └─────────────┘ └─────────────┘ └─────────────┘ │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ## 模块说明 / Module Description ### 模型层 / Models Layer (`code_memory/models/`) - `base.py`: 基础类型和枚举定义 - `entities.py`: 代码实体模型（函数、类、方法等） - `relations.py`: 代码关系模型（调用、继承、导入等） - `ast_models.py`: AST节点模型 - `graphs.py`: 图结构模型 ### 解析器层 / Parsers Layer (`code_memory/parsers/`) - `base.py`: 解析器基类和注册表 - `python_parser.py`: Python代码解析器 ### 提取器层 / Extractors Layer (`code_memory/extractors/`) - `visitors.py`: AST访问者模式实现 - `entity_extractor.py`: 实体提取器 - `relation_extractor.py`: 关系提取器 - `ast_extractor.py`: 综合AST提取器 ### 存储层 / Storage Layer (`code_memory/storage/`) - `vector_store.py`: 向量存储（InMemory/Chroma/FAISS） - `graph_store.py`: 图存储（InMemory/NetworkX） - `document_store.py`: 文档存储（InMemory/SQLite） ### 嵌入层 / Embeddings Layer (`code_memory/embeddings/`) - `base.py`: 嵌入器基类 - `embedders.py`: 嵌入器实现（CodeBERT/UniXcoder/OpenAI） ### 检索层 / Retrieval Layer (`code_memory/retrieval/`) - `base.py`: 检索器基类 - `retrievers.py`: 检索器实现（语义/结构/词汇/混合/融合） ### 图分析层 / Graph Analysis Layer (`code_memory/graph/`) - `analyzers.py`: 图分析器（调用图/继承图/依赖图） ### 内存管理层 / Memory Management Layer (`code_memory/memory/`) - `managers.py`: 内存管理器（会话/项目/跨项目） ### 索引层 / Indexing Layer (`code_memory/indexing/`) - `indexer.py`: 增量索引器和调度器 ### API层 / API Layer (`code_memory/api/`) - `code_memory.py`: 主API类 ## API参考 / API Reference ### CodeMemory 类 ```python class CodeMemory: def __init__(self, config: Optional[Dict] = None): ... # 项目管理 / Project Management def init_project(self, project_name: str, project_path: str, **kwargs) -> None: ... def index_project(self, project_name: str, incremental: bool = True) -> Dict: ... def switch_project(self, project_name: str) -> None: ... def list_projects(self) -> List[str]: ... def delete_project(self, project_name: str) -> None: ... # 搜索 / Search def search(self, query: str, mode: str = "hybrid", limit: int = 10, filters: Optional[Dict] = None) -> List[Dict]: ... def find_entity(self, name: str, exact_match: bool = False) -> List[Dict]: ... # 图分析 / Graph Analysis def analyze_call_chain(self, function_name: str, max_depth: int = 3) -> Dict: ... def analyze_class_hierarchy(self, class_name: str) -> Dict: ... def analyze_dependencies(self) -> Dict: ... def get_graph_metrics(self) -> Dict: ... # 统计 / Statistics def get_statistics(self, detailed: bool = False) -> Dict: ... # 导出 / Export def export(self, output_path: str, format: str = "json") -> None: ... ``` ## 配置 / Configuration ```python config = { # 存储配置 / Storage Configuration "storage": { "vector_store": "chroma", # chroma, faiss, inmemory "graph_store": "networkx", # networkx, inmemory "document_store": "sqlite", # sqlite, inmemory "persist_path": "~/.code_memory", }, # 嵌入配置 / Embedding Configuration "embedding": { "model": "codebert", # codebert, unixcoder, openai "dimension": 768, "batch_size": 32, }, # 检索配置 / Retrieval Configuration "retrieval": { "default_mode": "hybrid", "semantic_weight": 0.4, "structural_weight": 0.3, "lexical_weight": 0.3, }, # 索引配置 / Indexing Configuration "indexing": { "exclude_patterns": ["__pycache__", ".git", "node_modules"], "file_extensions": [".py"], "max_file_size": 1048576, # 1MB "parallel_workers": 4, }, } cm = CodeMemory(config=config) ``` ## 支持的语言 / Supported Languages | 语言 / Language | 状态 / Status | 解析器 / Parser | |----------------|---------------|-----------------| | Python | ✅ 完整支持 | Built-in AST | | JavaScript | 🚧 计划中 | Tree-sitter | | TypeScript | 🚧 计划中 | Tree-sitter | | Java | 🚧 计划中 | Tree-sitter | | Go | 🚧 计划中 | Tree-sitter | | Rust | 🚧 计划中 | Tree-sitter | ## 贡献 / Contributing 欢迎贡献！请查看 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) 了解详情。 Contributions are welcome! Please see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for details. ## 许可证 / License MIT License - 详见 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 文件。 MIT License - See [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details. ## 致谢 / Acknowledgments - [NetworkX](https://networkx.org/) - 图处理 - [ChromaDB](https://www.trychroma.com/) - 向量存储 - [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/) - 预训练模型 - [Tree-sitter](https://tree-sitter.github.io/) - 多语言解析 ---
